recognize_zh: 數顆紅血球（含一顆偏大、偏藍的多染性細胞）充滿均勻散佈的深紫色粗顆粒，符合嗜鹼性點彩；許多紅血球邊緣帶亮框的粉紫色小斑塊則是乾燥折光假影，不要誤認為包涵體。
features: Several red cells with coarse, evenly distributed blue-purple granules, including a larger polychromatophilic stippled cell
One small dense cell at left-center is heavily stippled with a bluish tint
A pale bluish round cell at top with faint stippling (polychromatophilic red cell)
Numerous refractile, dark-rimmed magenta crescents and dots at red cell edges consistent with drying artifact
Background red cells are normocytic with occasional target-like cells; a large pale macrocyte with a single central dot
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with scattered polychromatophilic cells. Several red cells, including polychromatophilic forms, contain coarse, evenly dispersed basophilic granules consistent with coarse basophilic stippling. Many red cells show sharply outlined, refractile magenta crescents at their margins, which represent slide drying artifact rather than true inclusions. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few clustered peripheral granules that are Prussian blue positive, unlike the numerous diffuse granules seen here.
Artifacts are sharply outlined, refractile and change with focus, whereas true stippling is non-refractile granules within the cell.
Howell-Jolly bodies are usually single, larger, round dense purple nuclear remnants rather than many small granules.
Intraerythrocytic parasites have defined ring or tetrad shapes with cytoplasm and chromatin, not uniform punctate dots.
